Pedophilia is a psychiatric term for a persistent sexual interest in prepubescent children, generally those who have not yet begun puberty. It refers to an attraction or pattern of fantasies—not necessarily an action.

Any sexual contact between an adult and a child is abuse and is harmful and illegal because children cannot consent. If someone is worried about their own thoughts or a child’s safety, they should avoid being alone with children, never act on the thoughts, and contact a qualified mental-health professional or a child-protection/emergency service.
